960.a: Kasamori-ji, 302 Kasamori, Chonan, Chōsei District, Chiba 297-0125, Japan
960.aj: 〒297-0125 千葉県長生郡長南町笠森３０２ 笠森観音
960.ed: Rebuilt 11th-century Buddhist hall on stilts, with a holy statue shown to the public every 6 years.
960.edj: 11 世紀に建立された四方懸造の観音堂（現在の建物は再建）。本尊の公開は 6 年ごと。

rv.t: Nice temple, wish we had visited a few weeks earlier to enjoy the autumn leaves. 300¥ and 100¥ to go to the submit. Lots of stairs to climb, not recommended if knee pain or for older folks

Kasamori-ji is a beautiful and historic temple with stunning views. The climb up the temple is rewarding, and the temple itself is serene and peaceful. It's a great place to escape the city and enjoy some nature.
The history place with the wonderful mountain sightseeing. The structure was so fantastic.

961.a: Katsuura Marine Park, 174 Yoshio, Katsuura, Chiba 299-5242, Japan
961.aj: 〒299-5242 千葉県勝浦市吉尾１７４ かつうら海中公園
961.ed: Ocean-viewing deck at the end of a pier, plus an underwater observatory for watching marine life.
961.edj: 桟橋の先端にある海中展望塔。海を見渡せるデッキと、海の生き物を観察できる海中展望室がある。

rv.t: We visited on a weekday unfortunately it was very cloudy and dirty in the sea on the day we were there. However we were made aware of this and it was a cheaper price. Overall it was a great experience either way and the sea being dirty can't be help
I got a discount (650yen) ticket due to low visibility in the sea. A nice place to observe some sea food lol You might get exhausted after climbing up from the bottom to the top of the building

It is a very interesting place to visit, the waves are very strong on the surface of the water and crashing against the cliff to create the beautiful gradients against it. Then once you enter the undersea observatory, it is a whole new world, very calm and peaceful to view the sea life through the small windows. This structure is build in 1955, making it 70 yr old today! What a genius idea 💡 and who would have…

962.a: Banzai Cafe, 1545 Matsube, Katsuura, Chiba 299-5241, Japan
962.aj: 〒299-5241 千葉県勝浦市松部１５４５ バンザイ カフェ
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
962.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious dishes, including cream pasta, Yankun fried rice, and Katsuura tantanmen pasta, and appreciate the stunning ocean views from the second floor. They also highlight the reasonable prices, the welcoming staff, and the cozy, at-home atmosphere. Other reviews mention there can be a lack of background music.

rv.t: This is such a cute little cafe. I have visited a number of times and have enjoyed tasty dishes, wonderful views and restful atmosphere. From the first to last I have always received professional and courteous service. As others have highlighted, Banzai has a spectacular ocean view from its second floor— a place to take your special someone to, your family, or to just sit and daydream on your lonesome. I have…
The food was fantastic and the ocean view is beautiful. I will come again.

The food was phenomenal and so was the service! The shakes were really delicious; we recommend the espresso shake. The noodle dishes were all so wonderful. My favorite was the bacon, tomato, cream noodles and my husband liked the spicy noodles the best. My son loved the green curry and the tapioca drinks were really great, as well. We highly recommend a visit for a nice lunch!

962.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

963.a: Music & Coffee Shop Misaki, 1 Motona, Kyonan, Awa District, Chiba 299-1901, Japan
963.aj: 〒299-1901 千葉県安房郡鋸南町元名１ 音楽と珈琲の店 岬
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
963.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, tea, and light meals like pizza toast and chocolate cake, with many highlighting the unique, handmade cups. They also mention the stunning ocean views from both the indoor and outdoor terrace seating, creating a relaxing atmosphere. Guests appreciate the friendly and welcoming staff, noting the cafe is also pet-friendly.
963.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、コーヒーや紅茶、ピザトーストやチョコレートケーキなどの軽食が美味しいと評判です。特に、手作りのユニークなカップで提供される点が高く評価されています。また、屋内席とテラス席の両方から素晴らしいオーシャンビューが楽しめ、リラックスできる雰囲気だという声が多くあります。スタッフは親しみやすく、温かいおもてなしをしてくれるというクチコミもあり、ペット同伴も可能なので、愛犬と一緒に訪れる人もいるようです。

rv.t: Oh my goodness what a cute place!! If I lived in Chiba i would come here regularly! The woman who runs the place was very kind and the service was quick! I just got an iced coffee and chocolate cake. Delish! The view of the ocean is so pretty and the inside of the coffee shop is absolutely adorable! I saw this cafe online and it was literally one of the reasons why I went to Chiba in the first place and I was not…

This place is located in a beautiful place where you can enjoy a stunning ocean view. They have running the cafe for 46 years. I ordered a glass of iced coffee and an original muffin. The coffee was very good. I love this place because of the great balance of their food/drinks and atmosphere. I will visit here again.
So chill here love the view of the sea might comeback again highly recommend this cafe shop

963.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

964.a: 1110 CAFE/BAKERY, 5 Chome-4-1 Ryoke, Kawaguchi, Saitama 332-0004, Japan
964.aj: 〒332-0004 埼玉県川口市領家５丁目４−１ 1110 CAFE/BAKERY
964.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious vegan cinnamon rolls, French toast, and a variety of healthy, plant-based dishes. They also highlight the spacious, green outdoor area, ample parking, and family-friendly amenities like a nursing room. Other reviews mention the food can be overpriced.
964.edj: クチコミでは、このカフェは美味しいヴィーガンシナモンロールやフレンチトースト、その他様々なヘルシーな植物性食品を提供していると評判です。広々とした緑豊かな屋外エリア、十分な駐車スペース、授乳室のような家族向けの設備も高く評価されています。 一方で、料理は値段が割高だと感じるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Vegan restaurant Went to try on the new spring menu. I heard about their famous vegan cinnamon rolls and sparkling kombucha dinks. And I was surprised, all was very tasty from the delicious different breads we had to the seasoning of plants and vegetables to create unique dishes. A must try of the cinnamon rolls and kombucha.

The cinnamon rolls are truly good, and the ambiance is espectacular. The terrace when sunny is great, and the park with shows and little market makes ir very lively. The only con was the slow service, which was very unefficient. They can improve the task allocation and speed.

Woah this is like the coolest place ever! It’s Part museum part garden part kombucha brewery, all plant based! So fun, so delish! Warning: they sell out so once everything is gone it’s gone! This was my second visit to 1110 CAFE BAKERY, and once again it was absolutely fantastic. This time I tried the seasonal menu, a demi-glaze hamburger steak served with a delicious bread roll and fresh salad, and it was honestly…

964.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

965.a: Suragan, B1F 4 Chome-3-1 Ebisu, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0013, Japan
965.aj: 〒150-0013 東京都渋谷区恵比寿４丁目３−１ B1F 水剌間 恵比寿本店
965.ed: Diners appreciate this restaurant for its authentic Korean dishes, such as flavorful kimchi, hearty bulgogi, and thick, crispy jeon. The elegant atmosphere and convenient location make it a great choice for both lunch and dinner. Some reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
965.edj: この韓国料理店を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、風味豊かなキムチ、食べ応えのあるプルコギ、厚くてカリカリのチヂミなど、本格的な韓国料理が高く評価されています。上品な雰囲気と便利な立地から、ランチにもディナーにも良い選択肢のようです。 一方で、店員の対応が丁寧ではないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: It was very decent Korean food, however if you are looking for something more authentic, I would recommend searching elsewhere. The store itself was very clean and had a nice atmosphere, however for the food, I felt the bibimbap was missing a little flavour. The banchan comes with the meal with a free flow system which I was grateful for.

Its honestly not what i was expecting and it doesnt taste or feel like korean food. The bulgogi was basically steamed with veggies. I wanted it to be more bbq and sizzling. The kimchi was good. The pancake was good too. The drinks are way too expensive. 1750 yen for one bottle of soju is craziness. 6500 yen for a bowl of makkori. It just didn’t leave me satisfied. Very disappointing when bulgogi is 5000 yen.

Great Korean food near Ebisu station! This restaurant recently started opening at 11:30 am for lunch. The lunch items are all sets, and include an entree, rice, panchan (pickles), and a soup (for some sets, not all). There is no dessert or drink in the set, but the food portion size is quite large. I recommend the bulgogi.

965.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

966.a: Chibi Maruko Chan Land, エスパルスドリームプラザ 3階 13-15 Irifunecho, Shimizu Ward, Shizuoka, 424-0942, Japan
966.aj: 〒424-0942 静岡県静岡市清水区入船町１３−１５ エスパルスドリームプラザ 3階 ちびまる子ちゃんランド
966.ed: Displays in a replica home of the Sakura family from the "Chibi Maruko-chan" anime series.
966.edj: アニメ「ちびまる子ちゃん」に登場するさくら家を再現した展示を行うミュージアム。

rv.t: I visited Chibi Maruko-chan Land in the evening, and it was a wonderful experience. We finished our tour just as they were closing, so the timing was perfect. Because it was late, it wasn't crowded at all, allowing us to fully enjoy each zone and take our time at every exhibit. The atmosphere is so adorable and well-maintained. If you prefer a quiet, private experience, I highly recommend going later in the day!

The place is small but very cute! With all the photo ops, you can finish touring around in less than 30 minutes. If you know Maruko chan, you will surely love this place. The entrance fee is 1,200 for adults. We were the only guests when we went there.

If Chibi Maruko-chan was a meaningful part of your childhood like it was for mine, I really recommend stopping by! You can wander through the area and see various recreations from the series, and it’s a fantastic spot for taking photos. There’s also a fun stamp rally where you can collect stamps of the Chibi Maruko family. They give you a Chibi Maruko-chan passport for collecting them, and it makes for a woderful…

966.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

967.a: Kakita-gawa Springs, 柿田川公園内 ７１番地の７, Fushimi, Shimizu, Sunto District, Shizuoka 411-0907, Japan
967.aj: 〒411-0907 静岡県駿東郡清水町伏見７１番地の７, 柿田川公園内 柿田川湧水群
967.ed: Springs formed by Mount Fuji meltwater visible from observation points & leafy pathways in a park.
967.edj: 富士山の雪解け水が湧き出ることで知られる公園。園内の展望台からも湧間を見ることできる。緑に囲まれた遊歩道もある。

rv.t: [Kakitagawa Park (Shimizu, Sunto District)] ​□ Elements ​・ Access Take a bus from Mishima Station South Exit (Bus Stop No. 4) and get off at "Kakitagawa Yusui-kouen-mae" (approx. 15 min). For those driving, a paid parking lot is available on-site. The park is located along National Route 1, making it easily accessible by car from Mishima city center. ​・ Time 45–60 min stay. This is enough time to visit both…
Small and beautiful park! Go see the spring water flowing from underneath the earth!

Most recommend place to visit at Mishima. Such an excellent nature piece where you see the foot of 🗻 San where the water is coming out. The water here is from 27 years and around 100,000 ton liters per day. You can reach here by bus or waking from mishima station. Nice place for kids too

968.a: Sawayaka Hamamatsu Wagō, 193-14 Wagocho, Chuo Ward, Hamamatsu, Shizuoka 433-8125, Japan
968.aj: 〒433-8125 静岡県浜松市中央区和合町１９３−１４ さわやか 浜松和合店
catj: ファミリー レストラン
968.ed: Diners like this restaurant's hearty "genkotsu" hamburger steak, which is served rare and can be cooked to preference on a hot plate, along with delicious side dishes like the fresh farm salad. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the warm, casual atmosphere. Guests mention the staff are friendly, attentive, and provide excellent service, making for a pleasant dining experience.
968.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、名物の「げんこつハンバーグ」を高く評価しています。ハンバーグはレアな状態で提供され、熱い鉄板で好みの焼き加減に調節できるのが特徴です。新鮮な農園サラダなどのサイドメニューも美味しいと評判です。また、手頃な価格設定と温かくカジュアルな雰囲気が好評です。スタッフは親しみやすく、きめ細やかなサービスを提供してくれるため、快適な食事体験ができるというクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: Wonderful family meal experience and for such a good price! Highly recommend! The strawberry parfait was especially fabulous 😍
Very juicy! but you won’t like it unless you like it so rare. This place is friendly for families.
I went there for lunch. I ate a hamburger lunch. It was 250 grams. It was very juicy, and I felt full. There were many parking spaces, so we could go there by car without worry.

968.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:45

969.a: Sawayaka, 439-1 Tomitsukacho, Chuo Ward, Hamamatsu, Shizuoka 432-8002, Japan
969.aj: 〒432-8002 静岡県浜松市中央区富塚町４３９−１ さわやか 浜松富塚店
catj: ファミリー レストラン
969.ed: Diners like this restaurant's hearty and juicy "genkotsu hamburg" steak, which is made from 100% beef and cooked to a perfect medium-rare. They also highlight the affordable "kampai drink" and the staff's engaging service, including tableside cooking and a "kampai" toast. Visitors appreciate the online queue system, which allows them to check wait times and wait in their cars.
969.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、名物の「げんこつハンバーグ」が高く評価されています。牛肉100%のジューシーなパティが絶妙な焼き加減で提供され、付け合わせの野菜も美味しいと評判です。また、スタッフがテーブルでハンバーグをカットして仕上げるパフォーマンスや、楽しい「乾杯」の音頭も好評です。オンラインの順番待ちシステムが導入されており、待ち時間を車内で確認できるため、効率的に利用できる点も評価されています。

rv.t: Appears to be a very well-kept secret of Shizuoka: A yoshoku diner chain that serves up a real mean Hamburg steak. Absolutely superb value and would highly recommend to any foreigners new to Shizuoka. ~12 USD for a 1 pax set meal. Be prepared to wait though - during peak meal times, queue times are in excess of 1 h. Which is in itself testament to their quality

A must try restaurant in Shizuoka. Their hamburger is one of the best I have ever tried in Japan at a reasonable price. Highly recommended! Be sure to get the waiting ticket in advance if you're planning to come for a meal. We waited for about one and a half hours before getting to try this delicious delicacy.
Great food and great staff! Can't believe we waited so long befire trying the place out!

969.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:45

970.a: Kaneka Orchard, 2241-1 Mikkabicho Shimoona, Hamana Ward, Hamamatsu, Shizuoka 431-1424, Japan
970.aj: 〒431-1424 静岡県浜松市浜名区三ヶ日町下尾奈２２４１−１ カネカみかん狩り園

rv.t: 味が濃くみずみずしく、とっても美味しいみかんでした^^ 迷うぐらい実が沢山で木によって多少味も違い濃いめの味だったり酸味があったり、味もほどよくみずみずしかったり楽しみながら狩ることが出来ました。子供も楽しんでいました。 景色が良くお天気も良く気持ちの良いみかん狩りが体験できました^^ お値打ちな料金なのにサイトからの予約で更にお値引きありお徳でした。

2021/11/14 10:00ごろ伺いました。 実は毎年いっている蒲郡オレンジ🍊パークが完全予約制になっていて今日朝あわててじゃら～んで予約させて頂いた経緯です。(^。^)y-~ 入園料は大人１人1200円です。 お土産が気持ち(笑)「十個くらい」つきます。 ロケーションとしては浜名湖が見えていいですね～ レジャーシート持って来てる人もいました。お弁当など持って来てもいいのかな～などと思いました。(こちらは農園のほうにお尋ねください。) 品種は極早生が終わって早生という品種のようでした。 う～ん、これは好みにもよりますが甘味は蒲郡に比べるといまいちかな～(^_^;) でもお天気もよく農園も清潔でとても楽しかったです。 帰り道、浜松でうなぎ食べて豊川のさんぼ道いって蒲郡オレンジ🍊パークでみかん買ったのですが蒲郡も早生の品種でしたが甘味は今一つでした。(*^^*)…
みかん狩りって初めてです、12月と思えない暖かい日でした… どの🍊も甘くて美味しかったな15個くらい食べたかな…😅 他の方のレビューにあるように敷物持参すると良いかもです。目の前に猪鼻湖で、またいつの日か行きたいです。大人1200円で帰りに🍊の土産付きでした、ごちそうさまでした🙏

971.a: Japan, 〒431-1202 Shizuoka, Hamamatsu, Chuo Ward, Kurematsucho, 1768-1 湖上百景浜名湖かんざんじ荘 展望広場
971.aj: 〒431-1202 静岡県浜松市中央区呉松町１７６８−１ 湖上百景浜名湖かんざんじ荘 展望広場

rv.t: パルパルのフリーパスでロープウェイに乗って行きました。 ロープウェイは10分に1本運行しています。 展望台からは360度浜名湖が見渡せます。 夕日も綺麗です。 00分にはカリヨンの演奏もあります。 休日はかなり混雑しそうな雰囲気でした。
ちょっとだけアップダウン。景色はきれい。老人は無理かな。
2022/11/08 広場というほど広くはない狭場ですが、舘山寺を眺めることができます。ちょっと草の背が高くて見にくいのが残念かな。駐車場も整備して展望台でも作ってくれればいいのに。 車利用しづらいから舘山寺も駅前もどんどんさみしくなっていくんですよ。

972.a: Olympic National Park, 3002 Mt Angeles Rd, Port Angeles, WA 98362
972.aj: オリンピック国立公園 3002 Mt Angeles Rd, Port Angeles, WA 98362 アメリカ合衆国
972.ed: 922,000-acre park featuring snow-covered mountains, lush rain forests & dramatic Pacific coastline.
972.edj: 総面積 922,000 エーカーの広大な公園。雪に覆われた山々や、緑豊かな熱帯雨林、絶景を誇る太平洋の海岸線がある。

rv.t: Olympic National Park is one of the most beautiful places I have ever visited. What makes it so special is the sheer variety of landscapes packed into one park. In a single trip, you can see rugged coastline, dense old-growth rainforest, crystal-clear rivers, alpine mountains, and some of the most scenic hiking trails I’ve ever experienced. Every turn seemed to have another incredible view waiting around the corner…

Best park ever we traveled from Denver. The drive itself is amazing it was foggy so it looked so nice. We followed to the Hoh Rainforest that had the moss trail it’s a loop took us about an hour kid friendly.

A very different national park compared to the many mountain parks in the region. Very unique flora and the gloomy rainforest environment was quite enchanting. Would definitely recommend visiting. Although not a part of the park, I would also highly recommend a visit to cape flattery which is near by.

973.a: Harumiya, 4 Chome-6-1 Kachidoki, Chuo City, Tokyo 104-0054, Japan
973.aj: 〒104-0054 東京都中央区勝どき４丁目６−１ 屋形船晴海屋 晴海乗船場
973.ed: People say this boat offers delicious food, including freshly fried tempura, and a wide variety of drinks. They also highlight the beautiful views of the city, including the Rainbow Bridge and Odaiba, from the large windows and rooftop observation deck. Guests mention the boat is spacious, stable, and has clean, modern restrooms, along with excellent service.
973.edj: この屋形船を利用した人は、揚げたての天ぷらをはじめとする美味しい料理や、種類豊富なドリンクを高く評価しています。また、大きな窓や屋上展望デッキから見えるレインボーブリッジやお台場など、美しい街の景色も好評のようです。船内は広々としていて安定しており、清潔で近代的なお手洗いも完備されているほか、サービスも素晴らしいというクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: It is a quality restaurant floating on the river! We experienced real Japanese hospitality (omotenashi) here. The staff were very friendly and caring. Theybserved generous amount of quality Japanese food with various drinks. One could view cherry blossom along the river. A superb atmosphere and ambiance.

The Japanese cuisine was very delicious, and drinks (including alcoholic beverages) were offered with unlimited refills. During the cruise, there were two stops where passengers could go up to the upper deck to enjoy the stunning views of the Rainbow Bridge in Odaiba and the Tokyo Skytree. The staff were very warm and friendly. However, it was a bit unfortunate that all the announcements and interactions with guests…
We had the best time here. The tempura was really good. The waiter explained the night view to us. Along the way they came to take our picture. Lovely service, definitely take my friends.

974.a: Komichi, 4326 Yamahigashi, Tenryū Ward, Hamamatsu, Shizuoka 431-3303, Japan
974.aj: 〒431-3303 静岡県浜松市天竜区山東４３２６ komichi
974.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and gently flavored dishes, with many highlighting the visually appealing presentations and generous portions. They also appreciate the unique atmosphere, noting it's a renovated church. Others mention the attentive staff who accommodate requests and the convenience of making reservations, especially for popular times.
974.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しくて優しい味付けの料理が高く評価されています。見た目も美しく、量も多いという声が多くあります。また、改装された教会というユニークな雰囲気も気に入ったという声があります。リクエストに対応してくれるスタッフの気配りや、特に人気の時間帯は予約ができる便利さも評価されています。

rv.t: Launchのkomichi B 2650円 デザート 400円 前菜が豪華で手が込んでます。 メインは選べてパエリアにしてみましたが、お米がベチャッとしていたのが残念。 でも量も味も雰囲気もすごく満足です。
教会だったところをリノベしたカフェ。夜営業も始まって嬉しいかぎりです。冬はちょっと寒いけど、膝かけなどで対応あり。初回は、駐車場がちょこっとわかり難いかも。 お料理は、どれも美味しいです。再開してからは、大人のメニューになり、やはりお酒も飲めるようにならなければと思いました。 このお料理をつまみにいただくお酒は おいしいだろうなと思います。
ランチで突然１人でうかがいましたがオープン時で空いていたので入れました。 お料理の味もお店の雰囲気もよく ゆっくりできました！ 次回はお友達とうかがいたいと思います

ネットで事前予約をすると予約日前日に確認の電話連絡をくれます。強風予報など天候によっては急遽キャンセルになる場合もありました。当日は、まず体調などをチェックし、一通りの流れを把握出来る映像を見たあとに、トイレを済ませてから お店の車で参加者全員で 更に15分ほど山を登った高台まで行きます。そこで装備を装着し、飛び立つ練習、空中での姿勢、着地の仕方などを教わります。鉄棒のような器具にぶら下がって空中での体勢の練習もさせて貰えるので、とても分かりやすく飛んでる時の感じがイメージし易く安心です。その後はブロの方に身を任せ…

rv.t: お店はアスモ不動産が運営されていて、 **「人との繋がり」**をコンセプトにした レンタルスペース併設のカフェ☕️ 本格的なカレーがいただけるとのことで伺いました🍛 スパイス感はしっかりしていて、 その点はとても良かったのですが、 私には旨味がかなり控えめに感じられ、 正直なところ最後まで食べきるのが少し大変でした🥺 チキンバターカレーはまだ食べやすかったものの、 それでもコクや旨味が物足りず、 「美味しい！」と感じるまではいかなかったのが残念です🙏 旨味のあるカレーに慣れている友人も、 同じような感想でした。 ただ、これは完全に好みや味覚の違いだと思うので、 スパイス感重視の方にはハマるお店だと思います^ ^ 実際、評判はとても良いみたいです♡
初めて行きました。 場所も分かりやすく駐車場も沢山有りました。 とても落ち着いた雰囲気でのんびり食事が出来ました。 グラタンとスィーツ、ドリンクのセットのランチをいだきました。 どれもとても美味しく、また行きたいと思っています。
ドライブしていてたどり着きました。 雰囲気が良さそうだったのでモーニングで利用。 店内は広くて居心地が良いです。 モーニングのお粥は薬膳で少し苦手な物もありましたが、普通のパンモーニングは美味しかったです。 スタッフさんの感じは良いです。薬膳についても説明してくれました。 お値段はモーニングにしては少しお高めかなと思いました。

986.a: Japan, 〒432-8061 Shizuoka, Hamamatsu, Chuo Ward, Irinocho, 824-1 土鍋炊きごはん定食屋 米つむぎ
986.aj: 〒432-8061 静岡県浜松市中央区入野町８２４−１ 土鍋炊きごはん定食屋 米つむぎ
986.ed: Guests praise the restaurant's delicious, glossy, and fluffy rice, cooked in a clay pot with free refills, alongside good small side dishes and a clean atmosphere. The unique, high-quality water and dashi broth served before meals are also highly praised. Some reviews mention the food can be inconsistent.
986.edj: クチコミによると、このレストランは、おかわり自由でたっぷりの美味しいご飯が好評です。様々な種類のメイン料理や副菜も美味しく、店内の雰囲気も良く、価格に見合った質の高さも評価されています。 一方で、料理の値段が少し高いという意見もあります。

rv.t: 工事中の時から楽しみにしていました♪ 2回ほどお邪魔しました。ごはんがやっぱり美味しいのと、メニューが変わるので楽しみです。お水やお出汁にこだわっていて、ちょっといいお値段だけどおかわりもできるし、今のところいただいたメニューはどれも美味しかったですし、デザートのシャーベットも時期によって変わってる？楽しみなのでまたお邪魔したいと思います。 ただBGMがちょっと定食屋さんとしては落ち着かない感じがしました。たまたまなのか？それともターゲットが若い人なのか？ スタッフさんが皆さん元気で丁寧に接客してくださるのがとても好感が持てました♪

日曜日、開店前の玄関先に順番待ち表が置いてあるので 10時頃に行ったら2番目でした。 駐車場は、10時45分頃にはほぼ満車でした。 開店5分前に玄関先に行き、11時に店員が出てきて 順番で呼ばれて店内に入り、席を案内されます。 まず、お冷やの水にこだわっているようですが コップの飲食店の匂い？がして不快でした。 値段は、お高め。 天ぷら定食→海老がデカい 酢豚定食→味甘く濃いめ、山芋は美味しかった デミハンバーグ定食→デミ濃厚 油淋鶏定食→ごま油、ピリ辛、チキンが肉厚 美味しかったのですが、結構なボリュームがあるので 少食の方は食べきれないと思います。 デザートは、いちごと甘酒のシャーベットで甘酸っぱくてお口直しにさっぱりして美味しかったです。 1回食べてみたかったので行きましたが 2回目はないかな…

器からお冷まで全てに拘りが感じられたお店でした。 メニューはお高めだと思いますが、拘りのお冷、お出汁、先付け、ご飯おかわり無料、定食も量多めで、デザートまでセットと考えれば、まぁ納得のお値段でしょうか。でもその辺の定食屋さんの感覚で入店すると危険です。覚悟必要です(笑) 土鍋で炊いたご飯が売りのようでしたが、どこのお米を使用してるのかの記載は無かったたですね。記載どこかにありましたか？ あれだけ拘ってるのにどこのお米を使用しているのかの表示は重要ではないでしょうか？ 視点を変えて、店員さん皆さん若かったですね。年配者おらず。 あと厨房が丸見えなのはこのご時世ちょっと安心。

987.edj: この滝を訪れた人は、美しく澄んだ水が流れる、穏やかでリラックスできる自然の場所だと評価しています。駐車場から短く簡単な道を歩いてすぐ行けるため、アクセスしやすいという声が多くあります。また、無料駐車場があることや、気軽に立ち寄れる便利な場所にあるため、ちょっとした自然休憩に最適だと感じているようです。 クチコミでは、駐車場が限られているという意見もあります。

rv.t: Sengen Waterfall is a peaceful little waterfall hidden in the forests near Hamamatsu. The water flows gently over smooth rocks, surrounded by tall trees and greenery. It’s not a huge waterfall, but the calm atmosphere makes it a nice place to relax. The walk to the waterfall is short (about 5-10 minutes) and easy, though the path can get muddy after rain. There aren’t many people here, so it’s great if you want to…
It was great to do a solo winter hiking. I had the hill and streams all to myself!
It is a beautiful waterfall, but the area not properly maintained at all. Trail from the parking might be slippery after rain as well.

1001.aj: 〒293-0041 千葉県富津市上６４８ 花はなの里オートキャンプ場
1001.ed: People say this campground is a haven for people, with many friendly cats visiting campsites and providing a relaxing experience. They also highlight the clean and well-maintained restrooms and washing areas, including some with bidets. Guests mention the reasonable prices and the option to purchase cat treats at the reception.
1001.edj: このキャンプ場は、多くの人懐っこい猫がサイトを訪れ、リラックスできる体験を提供してくれるため、猫好きにとっての聖地だと評価されています。清潔で手入れの行き届いたトイレや洗い場も高く評価されており、中には温水洗浄便座付きの場所もあるようです。利用した人からは、料金が手頃であることや、受付で猫のおやつを購入できるという声もあります。

rv.t: Access by: car or bicycle Ideal for: camping You can bring your tents and other camping goods as there is a wide ground for building up camping goods. If none, you can rent their bungalow to spent the night with. Toilets are built separately from the houses. You can rent a grill for cooking as there is no built in kitchen on the bungalow. Hot bath is also available. My overall opinion is: not bad if you don’t mind a…
猫と触れ合えるキャンプ場という事で、今回お邪魔しました。 評判通りで、頻繁にサイトに遊びに来てくれてとても癒されました。 猫によっては、知らぬ間にテントの中に入り熟睡する子もいたり、車のトランクに入り込んでくつろいでいる子もいたりで可愛かったです。 上の方のサイトも気になったのですが、今回は猫が良く遊びにくるA3サイトを利用したので、次回は違うサイトでキャンプを楽しみたいです。
去年から何度も利用してます。 金額リーズナブル、猫ちゃん達と触れ合える最高の場所です。 受付にカリカリやチュールがあるので募金箱に購入分お金入れて購入します。 どの子も可愛い🥰 運がいいと夜も遊びに来てくれます😍

1002.a: Mount Bandai, Bandaisan, Inawashiro, Yama District, Fukushima 969-3100, Japan
1002.aj: 〒969-3100 福島県耶麻郡猪苗代町磐梯山
1002.ed: This famous volcanic mountain features multiple climbing routes & several ski resorts.
1002.edj: 複数の登山ルートがある有名な火山。冬季には複数のスキーリゾートがオープンする。

rv.t: 磐梯山 • Mt. Bandai 1,816 m • 5,958 ft We began our hike at the Inawashiro trailhead. At least when we went, there were hardly any people! The Inawashiro entrance seems to be really popular in the winter, since it’s where the ski slopes are as well. If you want, you can hike up the path along the ski slopes to get to the quarter mark, but I recommend taking the ski lift. The cost is ¥1600, but it’s worth it. You don’t…

I had a chance to hike Bandai san on 20/08/2020. I would like to share my experience here hoping to help those who like to hike. There are a couple of trials. I used the one starts at Happodai 八方台 This is the easiest and shortest trial. I went there by car. I saw a taxi ad posted there. I will you can get there by taxi as well. There is a free parking area, toilets and a resting area while waiting for a taxi at the…

rv.a: Nepal Travel Guide (ネパールトラベルガイド)
rv.t: Although, we are from Himalayan country so we did not find this hilly top as a Mountain without snow , its look like a bladed head 😆 but that colorful jungle is always awesome in Japan.

1003.a: Mount Adatara, Kuromori Atamimachi Ishimushiro, Koriyama, Fukushima 963-1301, Japan
1003.aj: 〒963-1301 福島県郡山市熱海町石筵黒森 安達太良山
1003.ed: The range's highest, this stratovolcano peak features hiking trails, a summit crater & hot springs.
1003.edj: 付近で特に標高の高い成層火山。ハイキング コースや山頂の火口、温泉で知られる。

rv.t: At first I was worried since it’s my first time hiking but it was really easy! Like walking 1 and a half hours in the park. But the view was impressive! Perfect for beginner I guess. Might be interesting place for those who love moss.

This mountain can be done fairly easily if you use ropeway to the middle of the hiking route which will shorten the route by 1.5h one way. If not then add 1.5h one way to climb up. There is a discount coupon on the official website. From the ropeway station, it takes another 1.5h or less to the summit. You can also go along the ridge to try different hiking route too. Lots of bugs and green so highly recommend to…
Hiked here early May 2022-- Still wintry! Incredible experience, simply otherworldly views. Was very windy around the summit, so please observe caution. I highly recommend this hike.

1004.a: Seirinkan, 2 Chome-6-4 Kamimeguro, Meguro City, Tokyo 153-0051, Japan
1004.aj: 〒153-0051 東京都目黒区上目黒２丁目６−４ 聖林館
1004.ed: Acclaimed Neapolitan-style pies, plus pasta & sides, in a steampunk setting with Beatles tunes.
1004.edj: ナポリスタイルの生地が好評のピザ店。パスタやサイドメニューもある。店内にはビートルズの曲が流れ、スチームパンクな雰囲気が漂う。

rv.t: Went for lunch on a Wednesday (during the start of Golden Week) without any reservations. Queued 30 minutes before opening with 4 groups ahead of us. At opening, a female staff came out to ask each group for the number of people to be seated. Once you’re led in, she’ll tell you what level to head to for your table. Head there and there’ll be staff to point you to your assigned seating. The entire restaurant is…

Pizza dough was excellent as described and as it should be. Soft and chewy, great bite and texture. Topping tasted fresh. Cheese was mid, didn’t really add flavor besides adding texture. Bianca was slightly on the saltier side. Service was prompt. For the price, it was alright.

The pizza is a big disappointment considering this is a tabelog top 100 place. The cheese spilt a little in my pizza and I cannot taste the a good quality flour aroma or the chew. When there is only 2-3 ingredients on a pizza, there is no place to hide. The pasta is al dente and pretty good. Good deco for The Beatles fan.

1004.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

1005.a: TsuruTonTan, アクソール六本木 7F 7 Chome-8-6 Roppongi, Minato City, Tokyo 106-0032, Japan
1005.aj: 〒106-0032 東京都港区六本木７丁目８−６ アクソール六本木 7F TsuruTonTan UDON NOODLE Brasserie 六本木
catj: すき焼き/しゃぶしゃぶ店
1005.ed: Diners like this restaurant's wide variety of udon dishes, including creative options, and appreciate the generous portions with free noodle upsize. They also highlight the stylish, upscale atmosphere and the convenience of late-night operating hours. Some reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
1005.edj: おしゃれでムーディーな店内にはテーブル席、ソファ席やカウンター席が有り。厳選された素材を使ったうどんや和食がリラックスして頂ける。

rv.t: Honestly one of the best bowls of udon I have ever had. We waited about 30-40 mins at 7pm on a Saturday night, not bad. Order off iPad, relatively quick to come. Thick, juicy soup and delicious fat noodles. Generous meat portion. Bowl the size of your head. Sat outside and ambiance was 10/10.

Absolutely delicious late-night udon noodles 🍜 The brasserie has gorgeous mood lighting, and the staff are very kind - it was the perfect end to our stay in Tokyo! My friend and I both ordered the duck udon, and I would highly recommend adding the tofu on top - it was packed with an incredible amount of flavour. The cocktails are also delicious. Just a heads-up when choosing your portion size - the bowl and spoon…

Really enjoyed lunch at TsuruTonTan. The portions wete much bigger than I expected. I think next time I would go for half order of noodles. Everything was well flavoured and they have a very big variety of udon dishes. Restaurant gets very busy.

1005.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1006.a: Oyanagawa Gorge, Jikkoku, Fujikawa, Minamikoma District, Yamanashi 400-0606, Japan
1006.aj: 〒400-0606 山梨県南巨摩郡富士川町十谷大柳川渓谷

rv.t: This is so amazing place. I really recommend this beautiful place.👍👍👍❤️
Really beautiful spot. Views in every direction. Very nice local people too. Picture postcard views everywhere.
Lots of bugs and mosquitos, but definitely worth it for the hike! It takes a bit over an hour there and back and passes over some nice waterfalls and interesting bridges.

1007.a: Mikawaya Ryokan, 503 Kowakudani, Hakone, Ashigarashimo District, Kanagawa 250-0406, Japan
1007.aj: 〒250-0406 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町小涌谷５０３ 箱根小涌園 三河屋旅館
1007.ed: Airy quarters, some with soaking tubs, in a serene hot spring hotel offering a garden & a bathhouse.
1007.edj: 広々とした客室を備えた静かな温泉旅館。温泉風呂付きの客室もある。庭園と大浴場を併設。

rv.t: This is a traditional Japanese ryokan, and quite old. Our room had a small outdoor onsen, which was lovely, but no view of the surrounding countryside.|The staff seemed quite put out at our arriving at 12 noon, before our room was ready. Usually this is not a problem as you can just leave your bags and go off until 3pm, but this seemed to upset them a bit.. |Although we had filled in a form prior to our trip…

Wonderful location next to the park (and the territory itself looks peaceful and taken care of). The building needs some care though. We had a room with private onsen on the terrace and it was very convenient, but please note that the shower is also outside – it might be a bit cold not in the summertime, I suppose. Food was a bit blunt to our taste – both regular Japanese meals and vegetarian ones – but stuff made…

Went here as part of my honeymoon in February and I definitely would recommend. I stayed at the Open-Air Bath, Private Villa Type, there' an indoor and an outdoor onsen, tatami mats and a garden. The Villa is around one min walk up a tiny hill from the Main building which makes it very private. We had to go to the main building for breakfast and dinner. The food was delicious, it was nice to see that they…

1008.a: Japan, 〒153-0061 Tokyo, Meguro City, Nakameguro, 1 Chome−3−5 tractor morning
1008.aj: 〒153-0061 東京都目黒区中目黒１丁目３−５ tractor morning
1008.ed: Reviewers praise this cafe for its delicious and customizable toast and egg plates, highlighting tasty toppings such as avocado and baked tomato. Other reviews mention the service can be abrupt and the staff can rush customers.
1008.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しくてカスタマイズできるトーストと卵のプレートが高く評価されています。アボカドや焼きトマトなど、美味しいトッピングもおすすめとして挙げられています。 一方で、サービスがあまり丁寧でなく、急かされることがあるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Good traditional western breakfast options with eggs focus. I got the Eggs Royal and cold brew. Laid back atmosphere on a mid week brunch time visit with good music. Service was friendly. Definitely would recommend.

I do not at all understand the negative reviews. I had a great meal and both the waiter and chef were so kind, even though my Japanese is very basic. There was even gluten free bread on the menu and my allergies were kindly catered for. I didn’t have to wait for a table at all (lunchtime on a weekday). It is a small cafe so I can see how on busy days a wait might be required. Thank you for my lovely brunch.

The café itself is really nice: the food is very tasty, everything feels fresh, and the quality of ingredients is great. Unfortunately, the overall experience is seriously affected by the staff and some very strange, inflexible rules. It feels like certain rules are made for the sake of rules rather than for the comfort of the guests. I genuinely feel sorry for people who come here with any kind of requests — it…

1009.a: Mitsutogeyama, Kawaguchi, Fujikawaguchiko, Minamitsuru District, Yamanashi 401-0304, Japan
1009.aj: 〒401-0304 山梨県南都留郡富士河口湖町河口 三ッ峠山
1009.ed: Towering peak offering hiking & mountain-climbing paths, plus sweeping views of the area.
1009.edj: ハイキング コースとクライミング コースのある高い山。山頂から地域の景色を一望できる。

rv.t: I started the hike from the upper station of the Mt. Fuji Panoramic Ropeway. The information sign at the trailhead recommends preparing for a 6-hour round trip, but it’s definitely doable in 4 hours. The path leads through a forest with a couple viewpoints of Fuji. The ascent isn’t steep, but it can get a bit slippery because of fallen leaves and after rain. There are tables with benches near the top, so I’d…

Pretty easy walk, nice view all over the hike ! Up there, there is a deink machine with water, coke and other coffee bottles. Have coins and cash with you ! Free parking lot in the city with a lot of space available. Toilets available at the beginning of the hike. Nice waterfall as well

For the love of god, I strongly suggest you read up on the trail from Mitsutoge station to the peak and then back down to Kawaguchi station. You’re pretty much going uphill gradually for most of the trail and then you have to deal with a very steep incline during that last mile or so when you’re already tired. Many people online, like on Alltrails, suggested this particular route but we were the only ones going in…

1010.a: Japan, 〒682-0123 Tottori, Tōhaku District, Misasa, 901番地1 三朝ヨーグルト
1010.aj: 〒682-0123 鳥取県東伯郡三朝町三朝901番地1 三朝ヨーグルト
catj: フローズン ヨーグルト ショップ
ソフトドリンク販売店
1010.ed: People say this yogurt shop offers a wide variety of delicious and rich yogurts, including drinking yogurt and yogurt butter sandwiches. They also highlight the clean and stylish interior, with many seats offering scenic views of the river. Guests mention the convenient take-out options and the late operating hours, making it a great stop after a hot spring visit.
1010.edj: このヨーグルトショップを利用した人は、飲むヨーグルトやヨーグルトバターサンドなど、美味しくて濃厚なヨーグルトが豊富に揃っていると評価しています。清潔感のあるおしゃれな店内には、川の景色を眺められる席が多く、ゆったりと過ごせるという声もあります。テイクアウトも可能で、夜遅くまで営業しているため、温泉上がりに立ち寄るのもおすすめのようです。

rv.t: Exceptional youghurt. You can taste the quality. I will definitely come back next time i am in Misasa. The staff was also welcoming and helped me choose a good Yoghurt. I dont know any japanese, but i felt like it was no need either at this coffee. shop.
Bought a Coffee Latte. Even though the Latte wasn’t same as other place’s Latte, like no foam. But it was nice and tasty after all.
It’s a pretty cafe by the river so I can see why it’s popular among the tourists. However, an English menu would be nice for foreign tourists.

1010.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

1011.a: Fuji Fish Standing Bar, 5 Chome-15-5 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa Ward, Osaka, 532-0011, Japan
1011.aj: 〒532-0011 大阪府大阪市淀川区西中島５丁目１５−５ 魚屋スタンド ふじ
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店
1011.ed: Diners say this restaurant offers fresh, delicious seafood, including a popular "sakanamori" sashimi platter, and other tasty dishes like dashi tamagoyaki and kama yaki. They also highlight the reasonable prices, lively atmosphere, and convenient location within the station. Some reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
1011.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、新鮮でおいしい魚介料理が高く評価されています。特に人気の「魚盛り」という刺身の盛り合わせや、だし巻き玉子、カマ焼きなどの料理もおいしいと評判です。また、手頃な価格、活気のある雰囲気、駅構内という便利な立地も特徴として挙げられています。 一方で、店員の対応が行き届いていないという声も一部のクチコミで見られます。

rv.t: Gets busy really quickly, oftentimes there is a line outside with people waiting to be seated for quite a while, even though there’s empty spots in the restaurant. Food is good and comes pretty quickly. Nice and cozy sitting at the bar. Would come again! Tamago was so juicy and tasty! Not too salty.

The food here is very good. It’s like tapas but good size. Sashimi is very fresh so is the fried prawns. Tempura asparagus is so delicious. Grilled fish was cooked just right not hard. Definitely recommend coming here. Very well priced as well.

This place was amazing for lunch. If you're in the area as a tourist definitely try this place out even though there's a line. They have three lunch specials that come out very quickly because of their efficiency and how delicious they are. I highly recommend this place for their delicious sashimi set. The tempura shrimp was delicious and the shrimp was enormous. I didn't get a chance to try their Fujidon bowl but…

1011.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

1012.a: DozoSoba, 1 Chome-2429-5 Shinmachi, Kurayoshi, Tottori 682-0861, Japan
1012.aj: 〒682-0861 鳥取県倉吉市新町１丁目２４２９−５ 土蔵そば

rv.t: Level 1 of the restaurant is a shop selling pottery and also acts as the cashier for your food upstairs. You climb up a flight of stairs and be greeted by a rustic charm of the restaurant. Food is served piping hot and it is delicious! The staff were also very polite. Hot soba in a rainy day warms the stomach and heart!
Quite nice mood to visit with very delicious back wheat noodle! Especially I strongly recommend Zenkai (sweets)!

Interesting soba in Kurayoshi, the restaurant is upstairs in 3rd floor, basic menu w all Japanese and no English speaking...and no pictures in menu (Just point to a pic that has been posted). It's worth a try as its good soba and its like fettuccine shape which is new for me to try

1012.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1013.aj: 〒630-8262 奈良県奈良市北袋町１８−１ 松籟(ショウライ)
1013.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious hotpots, especially the Asuka nabe with its rich, creamy chicken broth, and the flavorful ancient rice risotto. They also highlight the beautiful, tranquil atmosphere, particularly the view of the 300-year-old pine tree from the second floor. Guests mention the staff are attentive and provide excellent service.
1013.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、美味しい鍋料理、特にクリーミーな鶏だしが特徴の飛鳥鍋と、風味豊かな古代米のリゾットを高く評価しています。また、美しい中庭の300年の松の木が2階から見える、静かで落ち着いた雰囲気も好評のようです。スタッフは気配りができて、丁寧なサービスを提供しているというクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: We tried the Asuka Nabe, which is special to Nara, and we’re so glad we did! My family agreed that this was their favorite meal in Japan. The milk broth was incredible, and the staff were so kind and helpful. I read that the chef is also an architect who designed parts of the building—neat! Overall, we had a lovely time and hope to come someday. **Please note that you must have a reservation, which can be made via…

Five stars!!! FoA, reservations are required. Please make a reservation via phone call or Facebook. Please reserve before going there. The restaurant owner only speaks Japanese, so English speakers had better use Facebook to make an appointment. It's literally the most delicious and relaxing meal I have ever had in Japan. The cocktails were decorated by Japanese Maple and the pot was so yummy 🤤. The restaurant host…

Quiet hotpot place near Nara Park. Me and my friend made a reservation for the white cream chicken hotpot. Very very delicious, very nice since it was raining that evening. We got seated on the 2nd floor balcony overlooking the garden. Beautiful quiet atmosphere. You need a reservation though, because they are always full!

1013.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 17:00

1014.a: Soni Kogen Noguchi Paid Parking, Taroji, Soni, Uda District, Nara 633-1202, Japan
1014.aj: 〒633-1202 奈良県宇陀郡曽爾村太良路曽爾高原 野口駐車場（有料）

rv.t: Very beautiful, a must see if in the area. Be prepared for a hike up the stairs leading to the top. There are no rails, wear good shoes. Superb views from the top and wide open grasslands even withoit ascending the mountain. Its like a scene out of a disney film. Just beautiful. :)
Beautiful view you can hike higher than what i took Also you can probably watch sunset if the day is clear
Nice place to go out for hiking from osaka/Nara

1015.a: THESE, カルテットビル 1F 2 Chome-15-12 Nishiazabu, Minato City, Tokyo 106-0031, Japan
1015.aj: 〒106-0031 東京都港区西麻布２丁目１５−１２ カルテットビル 1F Library Lounge THESE
1015.ed: People say this bar offers delicious, high-quality cocktails, with a unique concept where guests choose seasonal fruits for custom drinks. They also highlight the cozy, library-like ambiance and the attentive, friendly staff.
1015.edj: 本が置かれたアンティーク調のスタイリッシュな店内で、各種のビールやウイスキーを提供している。名物のカレーや自家製ピクルスもある。

rv.t: We were in the area and had THESE bookmarked on Google Maps for quite some time - so we stopped in. Luckily we were early (around 6pm) and a colorful, sort of secluded booth was open. The bartender presented the fruits and made us each a fabulous cocktail. Since we are not usually liquor drinkers, we switched to a bottle of wine and had a blast playing the games that were at the table! There’s nothing quite like a…

Fantastic speakeasy-style bar. They offer you a bowl of example ingredients to pick from, they recommend you pick one or two flavors, and a base spirit, and they make a custom drink. They don't prioritize seating at the bar, but perhaps this is so that more people can get sightlines of the bartender at work. I hear there's also an upstairs space.

This bar was such a hidden gem with amazing ambience and top tier service. The host was kind and knowledgeable about their cocktails, catering each drink to your preference. It’s tucked away and almost disguised as another house on the street but the two story floor bar was amazing and not overly crowded. I’ll definitely come back next time I’m in Japan!

1015.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 18:00

1016.a: Nakamura Tokichi Ginza Store, 4F 6 Chome-10-1 Ginza, Chuo City, Tokyo 104-0061, Japan
1016.aj: 〒104-0061 東京都中央区銀座６丁目１０−１ 4F 中村藤吉銀座店
catj: デザート ショップ
1016.ed: Diners like this cafe's rich matcha and hojicha desserts, especially the parfaits and namacha jelly, which offer balanced sweetness and varied textures. They also highlight the complimentary welcome tea, which is often a delicious seasonal brew. Guests mention the calm, elegant atmosphere and the efficient service, even during busy periods.
1016.edj: カウンター席をメインとした店内で、日本茶の他、ほうじ茶ゼリーや抹茶あんみつ、茶蕎麦などを提供。茶売り場を併設。

rv.t: Located on the fourth floor of GINZA SIX, Nakamura Tokichi Ginza Store is a premium Japanese tea salon from the long-established Uji, Kyoto tea brand founded in 1854. Hidden behind the retail area, the café offers a calm and refined space where you can enjoy a Kyoto-style tea experience in the middle of Ginza. The interior has a sleek modern Japanese design, and the visit feels more special from the moment you sit…

We ordered matcha parfait, the regular one, and hojicha set to try both. To start off, they would serve a cup of their green tea. The regular matcha parfait was already good for me. I appreciated the different layers of textures and flavors from that bowl. We also added a matcha drink which was too strong for my taste. Their hojicha is also on the stronger side. It felt like a deconstructed parfait so better to get…

Nakamura Tokichi is easily one of the most legit matcha experiences you can get in Japan. Visited the branch just 5 mins from Ginza station. This isn’t just another trendy matcha café. They’ve been around since 1854, and you can genuinely taste the difference in quality. The matcha here is rich, smooth, and deeply aromatic without that harsh bitterness you sometimes get elsewhere. The desserts are the real…

1016.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:30

1017.a: Shin-Osaka Prime Tower, 6 Chome-1-1 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa Ward, Osaka, 532-0011, Japan
1017.aj: 〒532-0011 大阪府大阪市淀川区西中島６丁目１−１ 新大阪プライムタワー

rv.t: 新大阪と西中島南方の中間辺りにあるオフィスビルです。 7階のKKCクリニックに健康診断で訪れる人も多いと思います。 (2021年10月現在) 1階エントランスを中心に外装工事中の為、正面玄関から普通に入れない状態です。 工事中領域を避ける形で端っこから入れる様にはなっています。 「ファミマ/タイムズ」と「その他ビル内テナント」とで出入り口が別れているので御注意。
新大阪駅終焉では、目立っている超高層ビル。 高さ８８ｍ ２１F この周辺は、大阪国際空港が有り、 ルートの真上に位置していまして、 航空法により超高層ビルは建てられません。 確か高さが１００ｍ前後。 直ぐ真上を、飛行機が飛び、なおかつ、 飛行機のタイヤも出ています。 最終の着陸態勢に入っています。 確かこの建物は、大阪都市景観建築賞受賞。 通称。大阪まちなみ賞。
ビルは普通のオフィスビルで落ち着いた感じですね。私が今回訪れたのはその中の人間ドックや健康診断専門の医院？ですがそこも看護師さんや受付のスタッフさんが丁寧でスムーズにいけたのが印象でした❗️

rv.t: 山登り後のランチとして利用しました。人気店だけあって予約をお勧めします。今回は、もちろん予約無しどお伺いしたので20分待ちで クワトロと天使のはちみつをチョイス🍯コレが良かった！案外ボリュームがあってお腹がいっぱいに・・ でも天使のはちみつは、デザートとして食べれました😋 また近所の山登りに来たら 行きたいですねー
北畠神社へ行った帰りにランチセット頂きました。生地が表面パリッと中はモチモチでチーズもコクがあって非常に美味しかったです！コーヒーもいい香りでした☕︎

事前予約していきました！(予約が無難！) 5人➕子供2人だったので古民家の座敷(机椅子席) おばぁちゃんが居たので机椅子はありがたい✨ 1人では大きいくらいのピザ🍕 薄めの生地なので食べやすく具がたっぷり 6種類頼んでシェアしました 食べきれなかったほどです。 (持ち帰り袋くれます✨) テイクアウトもできるので 次回はテイクアウトでお願いする予定です✨ アメリカ系よりイタリア系ピッツァが好きなので、大満足でした✨ 駐車場もあり

1019.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious coffee and freshly baked croissants, as well as its long opening hours. They also mention the spotless restrooms and the convenient location for a quick stop.
1019.edj: このラーメン店を訪れたユーザーは、濃厚でありながらあっさりとしたスープ、厚みがありやわらかいチャーシュー、そして味付けがしっかりしている煮卵が特徴の塩ラーメンを高く評価しています。また、漬け具合が絶妙なマグロと酢飯のバランスが良いマグロ丼も絶賛されており、セットで注文するとお得だと評判です。店内は落ち着いた雰囲気で、スタッフの親切で丁寧な接客も好評です。

rv.t: 美杉町太郎生在住の方が、‘’地元に美味しいラーメン屋さんがあるよ‘’と教えてくれて、一度行ってみたいと思っていました。‘’ただ、大きな車で行かないほうがいいよ‘’というアドバイスをいただいていたのですが、自分がコンパクトカーに乗っているということもあり、ちょっと軽く考えていました。 Googleマップで確認すると、先日訪問した‘’三多気の桜‘’から太郎生の方へ5～6km進んだところにありました。道中の風景がとてもきれいだったこともあり、ドライブがてら一度行ってみようと思いました。 桜が満開ということもあり、久居、一志町、白山町、美杉町にある‘’名もない美しい風景‘‘’が、車窓を流れていきました。事前に地図を頭にいれていたつもりでしたがちょっと道に迷いました。迷わないポイントは、国道422号を名張のほうに走ると左手に太郎生郵便局がみえてきます。その最初の信号を右に曲がります。そこから道幅が狭くなり急傾斜を登ることになります。民家の…

大自然を堪能できるロケーションです。 朝9時に到着しました♪ 1番乗りです、天気の良い日だったので、後からバイクの軍団が大量出没しました。 車の駐車場は４台ぶんくらいです。 ラーメン河のときは朝9時で50食売り切れ寸前で食べれた時間が14時くらいだった辛い記憶があったので開店直後に食べれたのがすごくラッキーに思えました。 塩ラーメンの味は言うことなしです。 鉄火丼も美味。 四季折々の風光明媚な景色を眺めながら食事ができるのは最高だと思います。 道中少し狭い登り坂の道もありますが見通しもそんなに悪くなく短い距離ですので気をつけて進行すれば問題ないレベルです。対向車には注意して安全運転で進入しましょう。 また来ます。

週末以前から行ってみたいと思って夫婦で食べに行きました 到着までがやたらと細い道が続いて、バイクのお客様が多かったです 私が頼んだのは 塩ラーメンと味たま生たまチャーシュー丼1500円 塩ラーメンは塩がきつくなくて、飲みきれるんではないかと思うくらいあっさりして旦那さんは飲みきっていましたよ チャーシューは豚バラが厚みがあって、でもメッチャ柔らかい 味付け玉子も黄身が半熟で柔らかくて美味しかった チャーシュー丼も下にタレが潜んでいてきちんと全体をかき混ぜて食べたら美味しかった（きちんと混ぜちゃうの大事） いつもは待ち時間があるようですが、今回は10分かからないで入れました（ラッキー） はぁ、美味しかった また行きたいお店です
